name: A calm week, seed 1
description: No events at all. Every day: Raj (soft, bite-sized IDDSI 6 diet) gets biscuits on the 10:30 and 15:00 rounds and tea and toast on waking; Win (heart failure, 1,500 ml limit) is given about 1,650 ml; escorted walks have the carer more than 2 m ahead; Raj sits in his wheelchair from about 07:30 to 20:00; Dennis is turned three times between 19:25 and 19:47; Raj and Peggy are given the 21:00 tablets asleep.
